issues.description: The visibility of PersonService.savePerson differs between template and solution: in the template PersonService.savePerson is declared public, but in the solution it is declared private. At the same time PersonResource in the solution calls personService.savePerson(...). This creates a visibility mismatch that will cause compilation errors (PersonResource cannot call a private method of another class).
issues.suggestedFix: Restore consistent visibility: make PersonService.savePerson public (as in the template) so PersonResource can call it, or alternatively update PersonResource to call a public API on PersonService (e.g., a public savePerson wrapper). Ensure the service method used by the REST resource is publicly accessible so the server compiles and runs.
